scope_note: Analyst-modeled syntheses are calculations from cited source claims, reported bands, public benchmarks, statutes, and explicit sensitivity assumptions. They are not reported facts, metered observations, audited payroll, claimed tax credits, or causal impact estimates. Each range is a scenario envelope, not a statistical confidence interval.

sources.title: Foreign-Trade Zones Board Annual Report to Congress, 2024
sources.notes: The Mesa FTZ 221 table reports 101–150 employees across all activated zone activity and reports Apple production exports in a $75–100 million band. The employee band is not Apple-only.

sources.title: FTZ Annual Report Tips
sources.notes: Defines reported FTZ employment as direct and contract employees within the activated area, with part-time workers stated as full-time equivalents.

sources.title: 2023 County Business Patterns: Maricopa County, NAICS 518210
sources.notes: County industry benchmark: 12,467 March employees and $1,182,395,000 annual payroll for computing $94,841.98 payroll per employee. Both employment and payroll carry the Census H noise flag.

sources.title: Data Center Air Management Tool User's Manual v3.1
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
sources.notes: Defines onsite WUE as annual onsite water divided by annual IT-equipment energy and gives an approximately 2 L/kWh U.S. average data-center WUE reference point.

sources.title: The environmental footprint of data centers in the United States
sources.notes: Provides state-of-the-art annualized PUE 1.17 and WUE 0.55 L/kWh benchmark inputs used for the low-water scenario.

sources.title: Historical Arizona Assessment Ratios
sources.notes: Reports Class 1 assessment ratios of 17% in 2023, 16.5% in 2024, and 16% in 2025, compared with the 5% Class 6 FTZ ratio.

sources.title: Foreign-Trade Zone Duty Savings Estimator
sources.notes: Describes FTZ duty-savings mechanisms. Public Apple Mesa records do not disclose HTS mix, foreign-status share, or effective duty rates, so the modeled export component is an assumption-driven sensitivity only.

estimates.label: Modeled onsite water use

interval.interpretation: Low applies state-of-the-art WUE/PUE; high applies a 2.0 L/kWh WUE and 2.0 PUE reference; central is the endpoint midpoint.

parameters.name: low_pue
parameters.transformation: Converts facility electricity to estimated IT electricity

parameters.name: liters_per_gallon
parameters.transformation: Divides liters to produce U.S. gallons

estimates.confidence_rationale: No Apple Mesa meter reading or facility PUE is public, and the site's cooling improvements may materially change the benchmark relationship.
estimates.decision_relevance: Bounds annual onsite water demand where no public meter series is available.

estimates.notes: A benchmark-based scenario, not measured water consumption or a permit capacity.

estimates.label: Modeled FTZ-area annual payroll

period.label: 2024 employment band × 2023 county industry pay benchmark

scope.label: All activated activity in Mesa FTZ 221; not Apple-only

interval.interpretation: FTZ employee band endpoints and midpoint multiplied by $94,841.98 county-industry payroll per employee.

parameters.name: ftz_fte_midpoint

provenance.detail: Midpoint derived from the official employment band

parameters.transformation: Multiplied by county industry payroll per employee

estimates.confidence_rationale: The employment band is zone-wide; the county NAICS benchmark is not Apple compensation and carries Census noise flags.
estimates.decision_relevance: Bounds zone-wide labor compensation for an operating-contribution account.

evidence_search.acquisition_target: Apple Mesa annual payroll, benefits, contractor compensation, and employee residence

estimates.label: Modeled FTZ export-duty avoidance

scope.label: Apple production activity reported for Mesa FTZ 221

interval.interpretation: Low assumes no dutiable foreign-status exports; central uses $87.5M exports × 50% foreign share × 5% duty; high uses $100M × 100% × 10%.

parameters.name: central_export_value

provenance.detail: Midpoint of the reported $75–100 million export band

parameters.transformation: Multiplied by foreign-status share and effective duty rate

parameters.name: central_effective_duty_rate
parameters.transformation: Multiplied by assumed foreign-status export value

estimates.confidence_rationale: The public report supplies only an export-value band and does not disclose HTS mix, foreign-status share, or applicable duty rates.
estimates.decision_relevance: Bounds one FTZ benefit channel without presenting it as a reported or total benefit.

evidence_search.acquisition_target: Apple Mesa FTZ customs entries, foreign-status share, HTS mix, duties avoided, and compliance costs

assumptions: Central foreign-status share is 50% and effective duty rate is 5%.
High foreign-status share is 100% and effective duty rate is 10%.
Estimate excludes deferral, inverted tariffs, weekly-entry savings, Section 301/232 effects, compliance costs, and property-tax treatment.

limitations: HTS mix is unavailable.
Foreign-status share and duty rates are assumptions.
Excludes other FTZ savings and compliance costs.
estimates.notes: Assumption-driven export component only; it is not a reported or total FTZ benefit.
